interface: Only the signatureInterface='internal' groups are kept. They drive slh_verify_internal directly, which is what this package implements; the 'external' pure and pre-hash groups need the FIPS 205 Section 10 wrappers, which it does not.
selection: Every parameter set contributes its shortest-message valid case, carrying sk and additionalRandomness so the same case also pins signature generation byte for byte. SLH-DSA-SHA2-128s and SLH-DSA-SHAKE-128s additionally carry one case per rejection reason, all six; they are the two smallest signatures at 7,856 bytes, so the full sweep is affordable there. Upstream has 14 cases at each of the 12 sets, 168 in all, and all 168 pass; committing them costs 10 MB, so 24 are kept and this file is the record of what was dropped.
